construction.implementation_origin: Written within this build; no standalone or other builds inspected or copied.

shared_schema.products: Unique case-sensitive trimmed IDs; nonempty name and casefolded brand; unique casefolded tags; nonnegative finite price or null; uppercase three-letter currency; scalar attributes with optional units; optional source.
shared_schema.preferences: Positive finite interest weights; ID/brand/tag exclusions; currency, budget and required-tag constraints; optional higher/lower attribute directions.
shared_schema.attributes: Normalized attribute names; values are finite numbers, strings, booleans or null. Units are casefolded strings or null. Price is a reserved comparison attribute using the common product price/currency.
shared_schema.provenance: Each normalized product carries its original input index and supplied source label through selections, rejections, comparison facts and tradeoffs.
shared_schema.validation: One normalization boundary rejects unknown fields, malformed structures, duplicates after normalization, invalid values and overflowing weight totals. JSON loading rejects duplicate object keys and nonstandard constants.

reused_internal_logic: normalize and its scalar/object/list/map validators define one product/preference contract for both stages.
The same normalized preferences supply stage-one eligibility and stage-two attribute directions.
fact, value_kind and describe provide shared typed, provenance-bearing facts and deterministic explanations.
Comparison facts are reused as the strict allowlist for optional callback claims and as evidence for pairwise tradeoffs.

cross_stage_handoffs.payload: Only selected ranked records containing normalized products, scores and matched interests.
cross_stage_handoffs.invariant: compare receives no full-catalog argument; rejected and lower-ranked products cannot become comparison candidates.

cross_stage_handoffs.payload: Deep copies of selected candidate IDs and supplied comparison facts.
cross_stage_handoffs.invariant: Returned claims must exactly match supplied facts, including ID, attribute, typed value, unit and provenance. Duplicates and additional prose are rejected.

behavior.ranking: Eligible products need at least one matching interest. Score is the sum of matched interest weights. Sort descending score, then ascending case-sensitive product ID; take candidate_limit (default 3).
behavior.constraints: Exclusions, currency (default USD), optional max_price and required_tags are applied before ranking. Unknown prices are excluded when a budget is present. All comparisons inherit that constrained selection.
behavior.comparison: Compare requested attributes only among selected products. Numeric preferences apply only to same-type, same-unit known values; text and boolean values are presented without inferred utility. Pairwise opposing numeric advantages generate grounded tradeoffs.
behavior.missing_values: Absent and explicit-null attributes are unknown. Fewer than two known values is insufficient_data. Mixed types/units are noncomparable. Partial conclusions explicitly cover only known values.
behavior.no_match: Returns status no_match, empty selection and comparison facts, and diagnostic per-attribute results.
behavior.errors: CLI validation/file/JSON errors produce JSON status error and exit code 2. Successful execution, including no_match, exits 0.
behavior.callback: Python-only injected callable; no provider integration. It selects structured supplied claims, which are rendered locally. Free-form generated assertions are deliberately unsupported.

included: Selection-dependent attribute comparisons and evidence-bearing tradeoffs
Shared validation, stable ties and provenance
Labeled synthetic fixture and integration tests
excluded: Live product discovery or provider calls
Validation of unrestricted natural-language callback output
Performance, market or client outcome claims

coverage: Exclusion propagation for product IDs, brands and tags, including tradeoff IDs
Interest changes change downstream candidates and attribute winners
Product fact changes change downstream explanations
Budget, missing price, currency and required-tag propagation
No matches, empty catalogs and single candidates
Invalid/duplicate schema inputs and duplicate JSON keys
Callback isolation and rejection of fabricated IDs, facts, provenance and prose
JSON CLI success, usage errors and missing input files

measurement.unit: One complete integrated composition build session
measurement.authoritative_usage: Captured by parent for this entire session as one composition label.
